tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: Could you tell me where the station is?

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Could you tell me what time the shop closes?” Change the verb in the tiles (is, closes). After the opening phrase, there is no do / does / did.
B hears the question and builds the answer. Remember the -s on the blue verb when it goes with he, she or it.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Where it is – after 'Could you tell me' the order is like a statement.
